The dial face is complex, featuring multiple concentric scales, numerical markings, and weather indicators (e.g., 'STORMY', 'RAIN'). A central pointer hand is visible. There is a distinct yellow triangular artifact or reflection near the bottom center of the glass cover. The image has a slightly soft focus and some digital noise.
